fato_historico: 1975: East Timor: Governor Mário Lemos Pires of Portuguese Timor abandons the capital Dili, following a coup by the Timorese Democratic Union (UDT) and the outbreak of civil war between UDT and Fretilin.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a refreshing wind of transformation, encouraging you to let go of old structures that no longer serve your spirit. Much like shifting tides in distant lands, you may find that leaving behind a stagnant situation opens the door to new alliances and personal peace. Embrace this flow and trust your intuition to guide your journey forward.
frase_do_dia: Release the past with grace to welcome the beauty of new beginnings.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual illumination and the bridge between two worlds.
conselho: Consider stepping away from any unnecessary conflict to find your inner clarity today.
